reviews.title: Finally, nutrition data in Apple Health
reviews.text: FitBee is exactly what I was looking for. It writes my food, calorie, macro, and weight data to Apple Health, so everything can be correlated in one place. I can then bring that data into ChatGPT through the Health connection to analyze trends and build a nutrition plan around my actual data. Simple, fast, and incredibly useful.

reviews.title: Simple to Understand and Use for a first time Calorie Counter
reviews.text: The app is the most beginner friendly app I’ve seen in a while. With the option to add as much detail as you want. The amount of calorie information on common foods is limited at the time of writing, but it compensates by letting the user add the nutritional content for themselves as well as share it with everyone else if they want! Only issue I’ve seen is a lot of duplicate listings for the same meals. All in all, a good app. I can’t wait to see any new updates and features.

reviews.title: Most convenient tracker I’ve used
reviews.text:
I’ve used a lot of trackers over the years. FitBee is extremely convenient to use with a lot of features that make it easy to track food including tracking yesterday’s meal, recently logged foods available to choose again, scanning labels to quickly add to your personal food list, and easy to edit entries. 
I appreciate the easy integration with Apple Health. My workouts transfer seamlessly from my watch to my FitBee. I am currently in a program where I need to turn in food logs. I can easily turn my day into a PDF and print it daily. Since I’ve started using FitBee, I’ve lost more weight on average per week than when using paper logging.     Since FitBee shows you how many calories you have left for the day, it’s easier to make choices as the day goes on.  With paper logging I added up at the end of the day and many times didn’t realize I went too far over my budget. I highly recommend FitBee.

reviews.title: Easy to Use, Awesome App
reviews.text: I wanted a way to journal my food intake. This app is not free, but not expensive. I felt in a way that if it was free, I might get lazy. I’ve been using this app for 2 1/2 months. My last doctor visit came back with tremendous scores in all the cholesterol, triglycerides, lab numbers etc. The numbers were just beautiful according to my doctor, and I had also managed to lose 10 pounds. Yay!  My goal is to lose 10 more, but I’m not rushing it. Day by day!  Feel so great because this app has helped me keep track of the calories. This works for me, makes me see what I’m eating and how much I’m eating and what choices I’m making about my food. Thank you, FitBee!

reviews.title: Everything I want and nothing I don’t
reviews.text:
Update: it’s 7/19/26 and the app just gets better with every update. I’m even happier with the app than when I wrote the first review. 

Original review: At the time I’m writing this, it’s been 18 days that I have had the app and it has exceeded my expectations. The free version does everything I was looking for that I used to use in the other app’s free version everyone uses, but the other app is now charging for things like barcode scanning. After just a few days, I saw that FitBee worked so well that I could just use the free version and be happy. I tried the free week of premium features just to check them out, and they are superb. I liked it so much that I went for the annual subscription.

I have already turned on a couple of people to the app and they are equally impressed. Had I known how much I was going to like the app, I would have bought the app with the one-time purchase offer. But hey, the annual subscription may help to ensure this app sticks around. It’s so good that it’s one of the few apps I’m happy to pay for to get all the bells and whistles.

UPDATE: It’s several months down the road now and this app has been instrumental in helping me lose 22 pounds and counting. The features keep improving and the library is getting more robust. I’m even happier with the app now. I can’t recommend it enough.

Second Update: still fantastic and getting better.
